transcript: == Track transcription == Yo-bama!
LPC
Hi there. I’m Bjorn, with Snarling Couriers, I’m a foot courier. And I’ve been trying to bring a package over there for the past three days but no one answered the buzzer.
Who are you - wha, what? Who am I, first of all?
LPC
It just says “Marvin” on there.
Where are you trying to deliver the package to?
LPC
Hey, it’s cold, I’m on foot, you haven’t answered your bell, what do you want from me?
I don’t know where you are, there’s no… I don’t live in a town where there’s somebody messaging packages around. Who're you… where are you located?
LPC
Hey, I’m on FOOT, fella.
Foot where, up fuckin… your fuckin ass, you stupid fucker?
LPC
My foot is coming towards YOU.

God dammit, what the fuck’s wrong with you? You hold a goddamn [unintelligible] of stupidity. I need it, I need it bad! I - I gotta have that stuff in there, you know what I mean? That stuff, I need it! I - I’m gonna be shook without it!
LPC
Hey buddy, I’m on FOOT. K, show a little respect here.
I - I’m - I’m - I’m on foot, I’m out in town here - [unintelligible], you didn’t bring my goddamn package, so I gotta come down here and judge for myself? Jesus fucking Christ!
LPC
You’re gonna be on the ground, is where you’re gonna be.

I’m on the ground right now, but I’m fucking [unintelligible] high! High up in the sky, motherfucker! Where are you delivering the package to, cuz I - I - I don’t think you’re delivering it to the right place.
LPC
Shh… I’m gonna deliver it to your face.

My face? My face? You wish you was delivering to my face, baby. I know you do. WOOOOOOOO! Now I know you want my package, I know what package you want. I got a biiig package for you, baby. Well who are you?
LPC
Hey, I’m a foot courier.
Foot courier? Well where are you currying to? I got a hot curry the other day, right? That shit was hot! Fucking hot curry! WOOOO! Burns yo ass down!
LPC
I’m gonna knock you in your face.
Knock me in my face? Now you gonna stand in line for that. Lotta people wanna knock me in my face.
LPC
And I’m a part time crime fighter.
A part time crumb sucker? A crumb sucker? I know you wanna suck on something, it ain’t gonna be no crumb though baby, Marvin ain’t got no crumb.
LPC
I fight frickin’ crime, guy.

You are crying, you should be crying. You’re on FOOT! I’d be crying too, my feet’d be sore if I was on foot all the time. [Unintelligible] score for you, a package! Good lord! I’m gettin - Marvin’s getting a little annoyed now man, you gotta bring that package!
LPC
Nope, this package is going into the dumpster, big guy.
Okay, bye!
